title: Three more minor issues
author: meyergru
body_snippet:
1. Sometimes, the tab titles change to "z". It most often happens, when I start vi in a window. Also, when I close a window by pressing Ctrl-D and reconnect, the title remains "PuTTY (inactive)".

2. The close button for the mRemoteNG application does not work. I can close the app only by other means (File-Close from the menu).

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Going one at a time.

**1. Tab title changing to unrelated characters (e.g. `z`) during a PuTTY session**
Fixed on `main` in commit `d7ae8b136` (`fix(#90): filter noisy terminal titles from PuTTY tab`). The tab name now tracks the connection name and ignores transient terminal title updates that curses-style apps (vi, less, htop) send over the wire.

Could you help validate on the nightly? Specifically:
- Open a PuTTY session
- Run `vi` (or `less`/`htop`) and hit `z` to trigger the spurious titl...

comments.snippet: Closing as resolved on `main`; please reopen if it reproduces on the latest [nightly](https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly).
